name: Ninth Hell
detailed_description:
ERADICATE THE DARKNESS THAT WRITHES BENEATH ALL OF TIME. 

In Ninth Hell, a primordial darkness has infected the very fabric of existence, tainting past, present, and future. You must hunt it down at its source.

Battle through six ravaged eras, each steeped in its own horrors, and carve a path through history's ashes all the way down to the ninth depth of Hell. Rage against the corruption as a Warrior, Sorceress, Rogue, or Necromancer, each unearthing how their past has sown the seeds of this nightmarish reality. Each playable class wields three distinct combat masteries packed with deadly skills. Forge your own playstyle, weave devastating synergies, and fight your way through legions of unspeakable darkness to seize this one, impossible chance to rewrite fate.

180 TOTAL SKILLS TO WIELD AND MASTER

Each savior wields 45 abilities, every one with its own skill tree. Raise a horde of conjured minions, then shatter them in a blast of bone and shrapnel. Strike with your blade, only to vanish and let a storm of arrows finish what you started. Call down torrents of water, then split the sky with lightning, amplifying the devastation. Every skill feeds the next — every attack a masterpiece of destruction.

DISCOVER RARE LOOT FROM ACROSS THE AGES

In the depths of Ninth Hell, power is never without cost. Relic items, torn from the mangled bodies of fallen heroes, now rest in the claws of the monstrous fiends that bested them. Damned items, once wielded by the realm’s fiercest foes, offer unmatched strength — at a price. And Erathreads, hidden throughout the lands, hold the power to transform your gear. Find the right combinations, and your gear will awaken as Bindrunes — artifacts of immense power that can completely redefine your build.

With each era, your arsenal deepens, filled with signature weapons and artifacts unique to their time. Collect, craft, and fuse their strengths to forge a style that’s entirely your own.

A HELLISH ENDGAME AWAITS

In the darkest corners of Ninth Hell, you may find Gateways of Perdition — each one a nightmarish gateway to a specific era and setting. Every gateway holds a unique boss, unique loot tables, and incentive to battle hordes of lesser fiends. These fiends drop fragments, which, when forged together, recreate the boss’s powerful gear.

But the true prize lies in the boss itself — defeat it, and you may claim its scale, a shimmering jewel that contains the creature's defining mechanic. Socket it into your equipment to wield its power, unlocking power even the steadiest of hands cannot control. Learn to control it and even more fun and build possibilities will be introduced!

PLAYER VERSUS PLAYER FUN

Test your skills against friends or strangers in Ninth Hell's PvP Act, filled with different arenas, each with their own charm, resulting in memorable battles.

short_description: History has been marred by ruin. You're here to rewrite it. Battle through six cursed eras and plunge into the nine depths of Hell, mastering 180 skills across four classes. Harness powers, forge your legend, and obliterate corruption to rebuild a world where peace rises from the ashes.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Spanish - Latin America
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 2500 or AMD FX-4350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 with 6GB of VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD strongly recommended.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 6500 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 or AMD RX 6600 with 6GB+ GB of VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD strongly recommended.

content_descriptors.notes: Players will encounter violent and gory scenes while playing Ninth Hell. There is also some mild nudity depending on the monster humanoid and when you take off your armors.
